q: Betwixt the square marble pauing stones, there was a space left like a list, which was filled vp with diuers coulered stones of a lesser cut, some proportioned into greene leaues, and tawnie flowers. Cyanei, Phænicei, and Sallendine, so well agreeing in theyr coulers, so glistering and seuerly set of a diligent Xesturgie.
1592, Francesco Colonna, translated by Robert Dallington, Hypnerotomachia Poliphili:
Once the bones are scraped, you could subject them to xesturgy, the process of polishing.
